notes: Gnarled Sage (M21), only YOUR draws count. Printed: 'As long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn, ...'. The turn passes to seat 1, who draws for the turn and then casts Thrill of Possibility (draw two): seat 1 has drawn three cards this turn, seat 0 (the Sage's controller) none. The Sage stays 4/4 with reach only. Counting any player's draws, or the active player's, would make it 4/6 with vigilance.
